changes.title: Dream stacked
items: A legend's dream bubble stacks the creature it wants above its face, and stays on screen when you stand close

changes.title: Nightmare face
items: A legend's nightmare shows one face that grows from slightly sad, through sadder and upset, to angry as it gets more restless

changes.title: Nightmare
items: A sleeping legend's dream now shows only when you're on the ground near it, with a soft glow on its side pointing to the nearest runestone of the kind of area it dreams of; once its area's soundsystem is on, the dream is gone
A restless legend's dream turns to a nightmare, the creature it wants fading out; it tosses and turns in its sleep
Speech and dream bubbles share one pixel style and grow with the creature: babies smallest, legends largest
